document.title: Quarterly report
document.summary: Excel workbook with a single 'Q1 Summary' sheet reporting monthly Revenue, Expenses, Profit and Margin % for January-March 2026. Q1 revenue totals 803,800 against expenses of 566,250, giving a profit of 237,550 and a 29.6% margin, with margin improving each month.
